描述_EN: yaozhou wares were widely popular from the end of the tang dynasty (618-906) through to the beginning of the yuan dynasty (1279-1368). the glaze that gives the opaque green hue to this object is known as a celadon. celadons are feldspathic glazes which derive their colour from the presence of iron oxide when fired in a reduction atmosphere (one with very little oxygen). while yaozhou wares are more commonly a translucent green, this jar’s lengthy firing period allowed for faint crystals to form in the glaze, giving it a waxy appearance. this jar is an example of yaozhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the shaanxi province of china.
描述_ZN: 从唐朝末年（618-906）到元朝初年（1279-1368），耀州器广泛流行。 该器物的釉面呈现不透明的绿色，被称为青花瓷。 青瓷是一种长石质的釉料，当在还原气氛（含氧量极少）中烧制时，其颜色来自于氧化铁的存在。 虽然耀州器物通常是半透明的绿色，但这个罐子的漫长烧制时间使得釉面上形成了微弱的晶体，使它呈现出蜡质的外观。 这个罐子是耀州器的一个例子，耀州器是中国陕西省制造的一种陶瓷类型。
